# hazard severity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hazardSeverity`](gmeow-hazardSeverity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hazardSeverity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)

The hazard's graded severity, when graded standalone (a hazard feeding a cascade usually inherits attention from the cascade's grade). NOT functional (review — evaluative, source-variable; the [`hasAuthorityLevel`](gmeow-hasAuthorityLevel.md) convention); optional, at most one per base graph (SHACL).
